page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with marginal notes in the right margin: "Sacculi ex serico confueda." beside the Sacculi paragraph, "Masticanda." beside the Ego paragraph, and "NB." beside the following lines. No footnotes.

main_text.p: riophylorum[?], cinnamomi; nucis moschatæ, macis, santali citrini, Zedoariæ, rosarum rubearum fing. drachm. semis, balsami garyophyllorum scr. semis, terebinthinæ quantum suffi. Cit ad incorporationem,
Ditiores, quique cupiunt fragrantius & carius, addant moschi & ambræ, fing. grana ij. vel iij.

head.i: Aliud minus pretiosum pro pauperibus vel tenacibu.

main_text.p: Recip. radic. enulæ, angelicæ, majoranæ, rorismarini, rosarum rub. ruthæ. Saluiæ, garyophyllorum, thymi vel satureiæ, singulorum partes æquales, camphoræ parum, fiat pulvis & incorporetur pro Pomambro.

Sacculi fiunt ex rosis, violis, majorana, pulegio, basilicone, thymo, Satureja, radice iridis, calamo aromatico, garyophyllis, lauendula, serpillo, origano, rutha, stechade, coriandro, baccis juniperi, melissa, floribus hyssopi, lauendulæ, saluiæ, rorismarini, & similibus, serico infu-endis.Sacculi ex serico confueda.

Ego nullum ingredior iter absq; Zedoaria,Masticanda. garyophyllis, corticibus citri, arantiarum, radi-ce angelicæ, enulæ, valerianæ, vel galangæ,NB. hæc enim & similia ore detenta & masticata venenatos habitus potenter discutiunt & avertunt. page.notes: Doubtful readings: the first word "riophylorum" is cut at the left edge of the scan, so the initial letters are uncertain. The "Sacculi" and "ex serico" margin notes are printed in italic and read as one note. The marginal "NB." is a separate mark, not part of the recipe text. The word "tenacibu." is printed with an abbreviation mark and is copied as seen. The line "Cit ad incorporationem" begins with a small c that may be a printing blemish.
